meta.purpose: Source-of-truth MySQL schema reference for FP Analyzer migration. Phase 2 generates Prisma schema from this; Phase 6 asserts live MySQL still matches before migrating data.

data_sources.completeness: STALE — represents the 2017 master DB seed template. Several platform tables (cms, cms_images, sliders, testimonials, site_settings) that exist in the live production master DB are NOT in this dump. See discrepancies.master_missing_tables.
CURRENT for tables present, but the live tenant DB has additional tables not in this template. See discrepancies.tenant_missing_tables.

live_connection_attempts.aws_rds: Not attempted — RDS endpoint fpanalyzer-instance-1.cqnzsmaqwblb.eu-north-1.rds.amazonaws.com:3306 is not expected to be reachable from this workstation without VPN/IP-allowlist.
live_connection_attempts.local_xampp: Failed — /Applications/XAMPP/xamppfiles/var/mysql/mysql.sock not present (XAMPP MySQL not running).

verification_required_before_phase_6: Operator must run `mysqldump --no-data --routines --triggers fpanalyzer_se_prodmaster` against live RDS and diff against this file's master.tables.
Operator must `mysqldump --no-data` against ONE representative live tenant DB and diff against this file's tenant_template.tables.
Any drift fails the migration script in §11.4.
meta.type_notation: Types are MySQL DDL strings verbatim (e.g. "int(11) UNSIGNED", "varchar(255)", "timestamp", "enum('Y','N')", "text", "mediumtext", "datetime", "date", "time", "decimal(10,0)", "bit(1)", "tinyint(1)").

ddl_excerpts.tbl_orders_create:
CREATE TABLE `tbl_orders` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `status` tinyint(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `type_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `order_nr` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `flow_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `equip_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `part_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `start_date` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `end_date` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `planned_qty` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `ok_qty` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `scrap_qty` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `planned_hrs` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `worked_hrs` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `remaining_qty` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `remaining_hrs` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `sort_order` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `deleted_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1 COLLATE=latin1_swedish_ci;
